第96章 借力打力，我的规矩就是规矩！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

林川坐在宾利后座。

叶知秋递上平板。

“林总，媒体投放的链路查清了。资金从一家叫星澜的公关公司走账。”

“顾总那边也查到，许泰前天晚上跟星澜负责人吃过饭。加上顾氏安保的监控，证据链闭环了。”

林川看了一眼平板上的流水记录。

“整理三份。”

“一份送到陆启明办公室。”

“另一份，连同律师函，发给许泰。”

他把平板还给叶知秋。

“纪委和审计那份，按原计划送过去。”

叶知秋点头。

“不起诉？”

“起诉太慢。”

林川靠着椅背。

“先让他们睡不着，比现在起诉更有用。”

他看向窗外。

“也让陆启明看看，他儿子是怎么被人当枪使的。”

陆家。

陆启明坐在宽大的红木办公桌后，看着桌上的牛皮纸袋。

里面是几张照片、一份资金流水，还有一段监控画面的截图。

照片上，陆骁和许泰在会所喝酒。

流水显示，许泰买通了公关公司。

监控截图里，许泰和刘顾问坐在车里碰头。

陆启明把照片拍在桌上。

“蠢货！”

他拨通了陆骁的电话。

电话响了很久才接起，陆骁的声音有些烦躁。

“爸，我正忙着……”

“半小时内滚回家。”

陆启明声音冷硬。

“不然我停了你所有的卡。”

半小时后，陆骁推开书房门。

“爸，你急着叫我回来干嘛？我正跟朋友……”

“啪！”

一份文件砸在陆骁脸上。

散落的纸张飘在地上。

陆骁愣住，低头看去。

当他看到许泰和星澜公关的流水记录时，脸色瞬间白了。

陆启明盯着他。

“你实名举报林川？”

“我……我是看他不顺眼。”

陆骁硬着头皮开口。

“老洋房改建本来就有问题！”

“问题？”

陆启明猛地站起身。

“你脑子里装的是水吗！”

“被人当了枪使，还在这沾沾自喜！”

他指着地上的文件。

“许泰在后面出钱买通媒体，把你推到台前去实名举报。林川要是反击，第一刀砍的就是你！”

“你以为你是在替天行道？”

Lin Chuan sat in the back seat of the Bentley.

Ye Zhiqiu handed over the tablet.

"Mr. Lin, the media link has been found out. The funds were transferred from a public relations company called Xinglan."

"Mr. Gu also found out that Xu Tai had dinner with the person in charge of Xinglan the night before yesterday. Coupled with the monitoring of Gu's security, the chain of evidence has been closed."

Lin Chuan glanced at the water flow record on the tablet.

"Make three copies."

"Send one copy to Lu Qiming's office."

"The other copy, together with the lawyer's letter, is sent to Xu Tai."

He returned the tablet to Ye Zhiqiu.

"The copies from the Discipline Inspection Commission and the Audit Committee will be sent as originally planned."

Ye Zhiqiu nodded.

"No prosecution?"

“Prosecutions are too slow.”

Lin Chuan leaned back on his chair.

“It’s more useful to keep them awake first than to sue now.”

He looked out the window.

"Let Lu Qiming see how his son was used as a gunman."

Lu family.

Lu Qiming sat behind the large mahogany desk and looked at the brown paper bag on the table.

Inside were several photos, a financial statement, and a screenshot of a surveillance screen.

In the photo, Lu Xiao and Xu Tai were drinking in the club.

Flows show that Xu Tai bribed a public relations company.

In the surveillance screenshot, Xu Tai and Advisor Liu were sitting in the car meeting each other.

Lu Qiming took the photo on the table.

"Idiot!"

He dialed Lu Xiao's number.

The phone rang for a long time before he picked it up. Lu Xiao's voice was a little irritable.

"Dad, I'm busy..."

"Go home in half an hour."

Lu Qiming's voice was cold and hard.

"Otherwise I will stop all your cards."

Half an hour later, Lu Xiao opened the study door.

"Dad, why are you calling me back in such a hurry? I'm with my friends..."

"Crack!"

A document was thrown into Lu Xiao's face.

Scattered papers were floating on the floor.

Lu Xiao was stunned and looked down.

When he saw Xu Tai and Xinglan's public relations records, his face instantly turned pale.

Lu Qiming stared at him.

"Are you reporting Lin Chuan with your real name?"

"I...I don't like him."

Lu Xiao forced himself to speak.

“There are inherent problems in renovating old bungalows!”

"Problem?"

Lu Qiming stood up suddenly.

"Is there water in your head?"

"I've been used as a gunman, and I'm still here feeling complacent!"

He pointed to the papers on the floor.

"Xu Tai paid for the media behind the scenes and pushed you to the front to report with your real name. If Lin Chuan fights back, you will be the first to be killed!"

"Do you think you are doing justice for heaven?"
